description: Read an ERC20 token contract on Base or Ethereum mainnet: name, symbol, decimals, total supply, and optionally the balance of one holder address. Verifies that the address is a contract. Params: token (contract address, required), chain ('base' default or 'ethereum'), holder (optional address). Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","chain":"base","holder":"0x622efA6Ceb83a5b6EdBC931332f4db68B7f74F27"}.

holder.description: Optional address whose token balance to return
